propositions: Repeated non-fatal LLM step call failures are invisible to callers consuming plan-review gate verdict JSON because swallow sites log warnings only and the verdict has no counter for survived failures.
Failed LLM calls funnel through a single seam (PydanticAIRunner.run except block) that records to a JSONL spend log but produces no in-memory verdict signal.
An empty overlap[] array from three failed judge batches is byte-identical to one from zero overlaps, making silent degradation indistinguishable from clean operation.

A new run-scoped contextvar sink in step_failures.py records failures at the runner seam, activated in plan-review scope, and drained into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty to preserve attestation safety.
coverage.llm_step_failures is shaped {total: int, by_step: {call_label: int}} and keyed by runner _call_label verbatim so keys match logged failure lines.
The failure count does not alter verdict string, exit code, signature, or provenance stamp; all existing swallow behavior and retry logic remains unchanged.
